_about: Registry of the writer -> reader rounds of tests/test_field_producers.py (P1-a spec 3.4, 3.5, 3.6). `readers`: one row per (writer, reader) pair - `id` (the reader's own name), `family`, `call` (`module:name`, the function or pattern the reader is), `writer` (a key of `writers`, or empty when `expand` builds the pairs from the package's own tables), `feed` (the named adapter that hands the reader what its writer wrote), `predicate` (returns_value | accepts | refuses), `round` (forward: the writer's value goes to the reader; reverse: the reader's demand is walked back to a writer), `agree` (readers with the same label are judged on one input: C4), `attr` (an attribute of what `call` builds). `writers`: where the value a reader is given comes from. `identity_groups`: one logical fact and the carriers that name its id form. `languages_source`: where the languages of the reverse walk are read. `known_red`: the ledger of tests/known_red.py - the red rows of today, each with its node and its own raised_by; it only shrinks. `hand_inputs`: family -> patterns of a reader's input written by hand in OTHER test files (read only by tools/lint_ratchet.py).
